main-debug     repro    40               40              
main-debug     static   0                0               

CONCLUSION: NumBytesGroupSharedMemory is a post-v1.9.2607 addition to the PSV0
runtime-info part.  No catalogued release emits it, and the fixed reader cannot
recover it from a release-produced container either -- the field is not in those
containers to be read.  So the byte count is evidence about the GROUND-TRUTH
build only, and must be quoted that way.  The release history rests instead on
the surviving `addrspace(3) global [10 x float]` and its store, which are present
in every release's DXIL (see manual-case-release-matrix.txt).
